The Deadmines are the center of the [[Defias Brotherhood]] operation, led by the ambitious [[Edwin VanCleef]], who is constructing a juggernaught at the bottom of the mines with the aid of the goblins. The Deadmines is the lowest-level [[Alliance]] instance. Its entrance can be accessed in the town of [[Moonbrook]] in southwestern Westfall, while its exit is located in the western part of the [[Dagger Hills]] near the ocean. Many quests occur in and around the Deadmines. ==History== From the [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Game_Guide/World_Dungeons World Dungeons] page on the official World of Warcraft Community Site: :''Once the greatest gold production center in the human lands, the Dead Mines were abandoned when the Horde razed Stormwind city during the First War. Now the Defias Brotherhood has taken up residence and turned the dark tunnels into their private sanctum. It is rumored that the thieves have conscripted the clever goblins to help them build something terrible at the bottom of the mines - but what that may be is still uncertain. Rumor has it that the way into the Deadmines lies through the quiet, unassuming village of Moonbrook.'' Prior to the First War, the Deadmines were the greatest gold production center in human lands. The mines also had an abundance of Whitestone oak lumber; it was used in the construction of some of the more important lattices and tools because of its resilience to heat and pressure.[[Jordan's Weapon Notes]] However, they were abandoned during the First War. During that time, Sir [[Anduin Lothar]] ventured into the perilous Deadmines on a quest to obtain the Tome of Divinity, but was captured by a band of ogres and held captive for twenty months. He was ultimately rescued and successful in his mission. It was also to the dungeons below the Deadmines that [[Blackhand]]'s daughter [[Griselda]] fled with the ogre [[Turok]]. Both were slain by an orcish raid. Many slimes inhabited the dungeons at that time, but they have not been encountered lately. For a time, the [[Miners' League]] was partly in charge of the Deadmines under the direction of [[Foreman Thistlenettle]] and [[Wilder Thistlenettle]]. However, one day the Defias Brotherhood attacked them during their work and the mine tunnel collapsed. Only Wilder managed to escape, while the rest of the company died and began to roam as restless undead. In Stormwind City, Wilder sent adventurers to find his brother, or at least his badge to give him some peace of mind.{{questlong|Alliance|20D|Oh Brother. . .}} He also asked them to find their union cards, in order to make sure their families get some resolution from this tragedy.{{questlong|Alliance|18D|Collecting Memories}} ==Geography== ===Maps and subregions=== File:WorldMap-DeadminesEntrance.jpg|Exterior File:WorldMap-Deadmines.jpg|Interior {| class="fandom-table" |- |[[Goblin Foundry]] • [[Harvest Golem Foundry]] • [[Ironclad Cove]] • [[Mast Room]] • [[Zanzil Laboratory]] |} {{clrl}} == Dungeon denizens == * {{RaceIcon|Ghoul}} [[Ghoul]]s * {{RaceIcon|Goblin|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Goblin|Male}} [[Goblin]]s * {{RaceIcon|Human|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Human|Female}} [[Human]]s * {{RaceIcon|Murloc}} [[Murloc]]s (one, [[Cookie]]) * {{RaceIcon|Ogre}} [[Ogre]]s (one, [[Rhahk'Zor]]) * {{RaceIcon|Tauren|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Tauren|Female}} [[Tauren]] (one, [[Mr. Smite]]) ==Quest guide== {| class="fandom-table" !Quest name !Quest giver !Zone location |- !
